caveat: This verifier reads Stripe live-mode active subscriptions and paid invoices, then records redacted metadata showing whether fixed recurring subscription MRR is greater than zero. It does not create charges, refund charges, change subscriptions, store customer identities, or prove retention, product-market fit, future revenue, or accounting-recognized revenue.
manualInterventionIfSkipped: Provide a live-mode Stripe restricted or secret key via STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_LIVE_RESTRICTED_KEY, or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY; test-mode keys are rejected.
Prefer a restricted read-only key with read access for subscriptions and invoices.
Run npm run verify:stripe-live-mrr. Do not paste Stripe keys, customer emails, subscription IDs, invoice IDs, or raw Stripe payloads into chat or tracked files.
Attach only redacted proof metadata through docs/commercialization/live-gate-evidence.local.json when owner-held proof is accepted.

checks.label: Stripe key is live-mode only
checks.message: A live-mode Stripe secret or restricted key was provided.

checks.label: Stripe active subscriptions were read in live mode
checks.message: No live-mode active subscriptions were returned.

checks.label: Fixed recurring live MRR is greater than zero
checks.message: No positive fixed recurring monthly revenue was derived from live active subscriptions.

checks.label: Stripe live paid invoice evidence exists
checks.message: No live-mode paid invoice with amount_paid > 0 was found for active subscriptions.
